name: naulon
description: Discover, price, pay for and cite tolled sources. Each paid read returns a Citation License a third party can verify against published keys.

interface.shortDescription: Pay for and cite tolled sources, with a verifiable licence
interface.longDescription: naulon lets an agent find sources whose publishers charge for machine reading, see the exact price before committing, pay the author directly, and come away with a Citation License that anyone can verify against published keys without calling naulon. Discovery and price quotes are free. Payment settles from your own wallet straight to the author — naulon never holds funds. Humans always read free; only agents are tolled.
defaultPrompt: Find tolled sources on <topic>, quote what each costs, and read only the ones worth paying for.
Fact-check this claim against paid sources and cite the licence for every one you used.
Show the proof link for every source you paid for, so I can check it.
